first_step_test: The left-pointing muzzle, head and seated haunch form one useful squirrel silhouette. The open chest-to-haunch gap reserves the later arm and acorn without erasing a keeper line.

source.notes: Contact sheet first; saved crops reviewed before publication.

final_elements.name: head and body
final_elements.description: One connected left-facing pointed muzzle, head and pear haunch, with a front gap reserved for the arm.

final_elements.name: rear foot
final_elements.description: One flat rear foot beneath the seated haunch; toe lines are clarified in Step 3.

final_elements.name: curled tail
final_elements.description: One large tail rises from the right haunch and curls inward at the top.

final_elements.name: two ears
final_elements.description: Two pointed ears attach to the top of the fixed head.

final_elements.name: acorn and forepaws
final_elements.description: One capped acorn and two forepaws occupy the reserved chest gap.

final_elements.name: face
final_elements.description: One almond eye, nose dot and short cheek curve on the existing muzzle.

final_elements.name: fur texture and shadow
final_elements.description: Sparse chest and tail hatches, acorn-cap marks and one broken ground shadow.

frames.visible_job: Draw one left-facing head with a short pointed muzzle. Continue the back into a pear-shaped haunch, leave a clear gap down the front for the future arm, and add one flat rear foot below the haunch.
frames.instruction: Draw one left-facing head with a short pointed muzzle. Continue the back into a pear-shaped haunch, leave a clear gap down the front for the future arm, and add one flat rear foot below the haunch.

frames.visible_job: From the right edge of the haunch sweep one broad tail upward and inward. Return its lower edge to the same haunch without moving the head or foot.
frames.instruction: From the right edge of the haunch sweep one broad tail upward and inward. Return its lower edge to the same haunch without moving the head or foot.

frames.visible_job: Attach exactly two pointed ears to the head crown and add two short toe divisions inside the existing rear foot. Keep the chest opening blank.
frames.instruction: Attach exactly two pointed ears to the head crown and add two short toe divisions inside the existing rear foot. Keep the chest opening blank.

frames.visible_job: In the reserved chest gap, draw one forearm reaching around a capped acorn, then a second small paw behind it. Put one almond eye, tiny nose dot and cheek stroke on the fixed head.
frames.instruction: In the reserved chest gap, draw one forearm reaching around a capped acorn, then a second small paw behind it. Put one almond eye, tiny nose dot and cheek stroke on the fixed head.

frames.visible_job: Use short strokes along the existing chest and tail curves, hatch the acorn cap, and place one broken shadow below the rear foot.
frames.instruction: Use short strokes along the existing chest and tail curves, hatch the acorn cap, and place one broken shadow below the rear foot.

final_step.visible_job: Deepen existing pencil contours and shade the established fur and acorn with restrained warm brown; add no structural contour.
final_step.instruction: Shade inside the established fur with short warm-brown pencil strokes, keeping the chest light. Deepen the existing tail curl, acorn cap and ground shadow without adding contours.
adds: color and value in established regions
